g.title: ER
g.text: 23 tables • SQL schema • PK = primary key / FK = foreign key / UQ = unique / NN = not null
Endpoint labels: 1 = exactly one, 0..1 = optional one, 0..* = zero or many.
Blue: accounts & finance Teal: assets & verification Purple: marketplace Amber: vaults
Composite PK / UQ constraints are listed below each table. Defaults and CHECK constraints omitted.
